notes.start: the base's parking spot for the unit (iaf-2026/data/airbases, airbases.md §5); the altitude: the terrain's ground there (elevation_m without the terrain)
notes.route: the departure point: 10 km beyond runway 25R's far end on its heading, 900 m above the field
notes.training.empty_kg: the F-16C Block 50 / 52's empty weight; the Sufa's and the Barak's are not published (inferred the same)
notes.training.takeoff_kt: 70 kt + 3 kt per 1000 lb at 20,000 lb (9,072 kg) and 48,000 lb (21,772 kg), linear between
notes.training.time_budget_s: fifteen minutes from the mission's start for the start-up, the tower calls, the taxi and the take-off
notes.training.heading_tolerance_deg: the climb-out on the runway heading within 10 degrees

footnotes.oa: OurAirports, airports.csv (public domain; LLRM elevation 2126 ft), https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/airports.csv
footnotes.bms-told: Falcon BMS forum, "Rotation speed" (the F-16's take-off speed: 70 kt plus 3 kt per 1000 lb of gross weight, a pilot's rule from the -1's charts; a forum post, weak), https://forum.falcon-bms.com/post/314659
footnotes.w-f16-spec: Wikipedia, "General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon", Specifications (F-16C Block 50 / 52): empty weight 18,900 lb (8,573 kg), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Dynamics_F-16_Fighting_Falcon

briefing.en: Ask the tower for start-up, taxi and take-off, taxi to runway 25R and take off on its heading.
briefing.he: בקש מהמגדל התנעה, הסעה והמראה, הסע למסלול 25R והמרא בכיוונו.

win.en: Mission - successful. Airborne with the gear up.
win.he: המשימה הצליחה. באוויר עם כן נסע אסוף.
